The system says: "Use every listed name/runtime state exactly. Driver, permission and tool outcomes never replace runtime availability." And "Never request denied/unknown actions." Also: "For an explicitly requested echo command, call exec when authorization is allowed or requires-approval: the latter is an approval request and must not be described as execution. Do not call a denied or unknown action."

So execAuthorization is denied (from action permissions: exec=denied). Therefore I must not call the exec tool. Execution: not-executed.

Also the user says "Do not ask for approval" — but since it's denied, we cannot even request approval. So no tool call.

- knowledge: state=stale; version=knowledge-P2.
